review.adapter_sync_only_ruling: Only built-in synchronous C callbacks are exposed; async adapter recovery must be extended before such support.

limitations: Offline checking/export/reference validation uses Python; the standalone execution process does not.
PC x86_64 validation only; 32-bit span checks do not prove RV32, DMA/cache/FENCE or board execution.
C CRC32 detects corruption but is not authentication.
Only static FP32/INT32 linear/add/relu support; no model/W4A8 binding.
Metadata stack/context costs need target budgeting; no S5 full resource ledger yet.
Adapter exposes built-in same-thread C only; future async callbacks need C-state recovery confirmation.
Independent review not repeated after author regression fixes.
